triage.notes: Read-only; no Apify actor was run and nobody was contacted. Counts: PF0L7uWMJ6iOPepQp actually holds 450 rows and P3WR3suDei2WkpAPy holds 100 (task said 443 and 92), so 550 rows were read. rows_whatsapp, distinct_pages and distinct_whatsapp_pages are hand tallies of the listing and are approximate (plus or minus a few). Of the 79 distinct WhatsApp pages, 24 qualify; the rest were known, older than 30 Sep, or non-real-estate. P3WR3suDei2WkpAPy added no new advertiser: every WhatsApp ad there dated 30 Sep or later belonged to a KNOWN builder. Selection used snapshot.cta_type == WHATSAPP_MESSAGE only; pages with a null CTA type (Mangla Group, Aaryan Gandhinagar) were not counted. Quality read: most qualifiers are small single-project builders or one-listing brokers, usually 1 ad per page; the strongest signals are Matangi Realty (6 fresh ads, Rajkot), Caladium Group (3 video ads), HM Patel (2 ads, Mehsana, a number inside the link) and Sambhav Developers (multiple project lines). Weakest on size/reachability: Nilkanth Residency (about 5 page likes), Ahmedabad Real Estate (about 10), Perfect Deals (city and identity unknown, no phone). Phones: only numbers printed in the ad text, or the phone parameter in HM Patel's link; link_url is the generic api.whatsapp.com/send for the other ads, so 6 advertisers have no phone in the ad (Vivanta Residency, Hillom Group, Nilkanth Residency, Perfect Deals, Shikhar Platinum, Ahmedabad Real Estate) and need a business-published contact from their Facebook page. Where ad body text was null (Caladium Group) the text sits in snapshot.link_description. Only one ad per advertiser was read, so project and phone may differ on other ads. Developer vs broker tags are inferred from copy except where the ad says so (Murlidhar Glory 'Direct Builder', Rudra Realty 'Brokerage Applicable'). Operational note: the Apify connector rate-limits parallel get-dataset-items calls (about 16 in parallel mostly failed with 'server is rate-limiting'; batches of 4 to 5 worked). Offsets in the notes are positions in PF0L7uWMJ6iOPepQp unless stated, for re-reading. About 58 tool calls used.

hiring.notes: Yield is thin: 9 new employers (8 clear, 1 borderline Cleardeals), not 30. LinkedIn public search shows very little Gujarat real estate hiring outside Ahmedabad. Surat, Rajkot, Bhavnagar, Jamnagar, Anand returned no genuine developer or broker sales hiring in the window except Vistara in Vadodara; a Mehsana query returned empty content and Morbi, Junagadh, Bharuch, Vapi, Nadiad were not queried separately (Gujarat-wide queries should have caught them). Dates are relative only ('2 days ago' etc.); '1 week ago' means 7 to 13 days and sits inside the 14-day filter (cut-off 7 Oct). No exact dates available. Many pages carry a stray 'Mahesana' heading, which is a search-location label, ignore it. None of the ads is a pure telecaller, pre-sales or CRM role; they are sales executive roles with lead follow-up and some CRM duties, so the signal is moderate (hiring to handle enquiries) and does not prove lead overload or a missing system. Only contact found: 079 Spaces phone published in its own ad. All other ads give no phone, email or website; websites were not found and no owners were searched, as instructed. Not tried: direct Indeed, Naukri, Apna, Shine pages (only seen as search snippets). Tool calls used: about 39. Apify not used, spend zero. Best three to review first: Akshya Space Consultants, Vistara Group, VR Ahmedabad Realtors.

rera.notes:
DISCOVERY BY RECENCY WORKS, via gujrera.com. The city listing pages (https://gujrera.com/projects/ahmedabad/, /surat/, /vadodara/, /rajkot/, /gandhinagar/) show the newest registrations on page 1. They are not strictly sorted by date but are close to it. The numeric ID at the end of each project URL is a good recency marker. IDs of roughly 31300 to 32350 correspond to approvals from about mid-September to mid-October 2026. I checked 12 pages and every one fell between 16 Sep and 8 Oct 2026. Page 2 onward (/projects/<city>/page/N/) would reach back to 22 Aug. I did not go that far because of the call budget.

THE 12 RETURNED PROJECTS WERE ALL READ. Promoter, project, city, full RERA number, approval date and project type all come from the individual gujrera.com page. gujrera.com is a third-party republisher. Its own footer says to verify against the official GujRERA record before relying on it.

CONTACTS ARE THE GAP. None of the 12 pages publishes a phone, email or website for the promoter. Each links to the official GujRERA record and a brochure PDF on gujrera.gujarat.gov.in. I did not open the brochures, and promoter phone numbers may be inside them. Nothing was guessed. To get a contact you would need to open the brochure PDF, find the developer's own site or a Meta/Google ad, or use the official portal. That step is not done.

LEAD QUALITY, HONESTLY. These are verified fresh registrations, which is the 'stacked signal' for timing only: a new project means enquiries are about to start. Nothing yet shows ad spend, a WhatsApp number or a missing system. Best picks to check next for contact and ad evidence: SNS Priide (60 flats, one small developer), Rosewood Heights (59 units, proprietorship), Shiv Aangan (64 units), Eden Eliseo and Eden Crown (Eliseo Infra, two projects at once), Sukhdham 24 and 44 (Shree Nilkanth Homes LLP, repeat developer), and The Evara and Swarnim Villa (Daskroi, affordable or villa segment where enquiry volume is high). Pushkar Hill, Mangalya Heights and Skywalk 56 are similar but lower priority. Avani Iraaya and Tirth Niwas have long timelines and may be bigger or multi-project.

SEEN BUT NOT READ (IDs near 31400 to 32350, probably Sept to Oct 2026, dates unverified, so not returned): Ahmedabad: Pacifica India Projects (Amara-ii 31741, Allure 31489, Zenith 31495; a mid-size multi-project developer, possibly too big), Neelkanth Flora (J J Developers, 32182), Kantam Apartment (Environs Realtors Buildcon, 32001), Arjun Parisar (Meha Infrastructure, 31985), Auracle (UE Living LLP, 32067), The Arsh Empire (Preyas Buildcon, 32021), Nityam Paradise (Balaji Associates, 31949), Hilltown Opulence (Balaji Homes, 31921). Surat: Pratham Aron (Swastik Corporation, 32304), Shantam Homes (Shantam Infra, 32081), Sangini (Vee Aar Life Space LLP, 32251), Pavitraa Happiness (Pavitraa Realtors, 31704). Rajkot: Matru Harmony (Matru Reality LLP, 31916), Shubhjivan Park (Shubhjivan Buildcon, 31798), Shivkant Silver (Gondal, 31826). Vadodara: Nilkanth Residency (31959), Meera Flats (Bhoomi Infraspace, 31763), Nexus 42 (Smaran Infra, 31472), Shilp Sparsh (Shilp Realty, 31816), Aarana Villa (Ambe Build Infra, 31890), Kesar Elegance (Anadi Infra, 30639). Sneh Enclave (Vastudevelopers, Nadiad, 31523). KNOWN list items that appeared and were skipped: Nitya Aurelia (Nitya Buildcon), Shyam Rivanta (Raghav Developers), Great Spaces Aaroham.

WHAT DID NOT WORK (do not repeat): (1) WebSearch for RERA numbers such as 'MAA17359', 'MAA174' or 'PR/GJ/AHMEDABAD MAA174 2026' returns nothing useful, because the search engine does not index exact registration numbers. (2) Searches for 'October 2026 GujRERA launch' or builder press releases returned only generic GujRERA guides and older registrations. (3) aurumproptech.in listings are alphabetical across 570 pages with no recency sort and no approval date in the list, and guessed ID URLs return 404, so it is only useful for one known project at a time. (4) The aurumproptech and gujrera.com project IDs are different numbering systems and cannot be mixed. NOTE: the user's MAA17400 hint is slightly off for the RAA/MAA split. October 2026 numbers include both MAA174xx and RAA174xx (for example RAA17439 on 8 Oct).
